changelog.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing you to tap an application's URI to look it up in the Google Play, F-Droid, or Apple App stores, which now also fetches app icons. An issue on Android has been fixed where cancelling an autofill prompt could cause the service to stop working. For desktop users, the Windows and macOS apps now use the system's native certificate store for improved connectivity. This release also includes several minor performance and user interface enhancements.

changelog.summary: This update enhances the two-factor authentication experience by displaying both the current and upcoming one-time password. The privileged apps list is now better organized, with separate sections for user-added and community-added entries. For more control, you can now also disable passkey support in the settings.

changelog.summary: This update improves Linux desktop integration by adding support for XDG Notification Portals. We also fixed a crash affecting users with the Turkish language setting to ensure a stable experience.
This release focuses on internal housekeeping and packaging improvements to ensure a stable experience.

This update resolves a stability issue within the generator to ensure smoother operation. We have also included the latest definitions for two-factor authentication services and updated translations for a better localized experience.
